description: This file contains unit tests for the BasketService class, specifically testing the TransferBasketAsync method. It verifies behaviors such as repository method calls, basket transfer logic, item merging, and basket deletion.

classes.name: TransferBasket
classes.description: A unit test class containing tests for the BasketService's TransferBasketAsync method.

methods.name: InvokesBasketRepositoryFirstOrDefaultAsyncOnceIfAnonymousBasketNotExists
methods.description: Tests that the repository method is called exactly once when the anonymous basket does not exist.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketItemsWhilePreservingExistingUserBasketItems
methods.description: Verifies that items from the anonymous basket are transferred and merged into the existing user basket properly.

methods.name: RemovesAnonymousBasketAfterUpdatingUserBasket
methods.description: Checks that the anonymous basket is deleted after transferring items to the user basket.

methods.name: CreatesNewUserBasketIfNotExists
methods.description: Ensures that a new basket is created for a user if it does not already exist during transfer.
